refs.excerpt: OwnedGroups.Validate(solution);var resources=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);foreach(var r in solution.Resources){if(r is null)throw new InvalidDataException("Null resource.");Require(r.Id,"Resource id");Require(r.Path,"Resource path");if(!resources.Add(r.Id))throw new InvalidDataException("Duplicate resource id.");if(r.Sha256 is not null&&!Regex.IsMatch(r.Sha256,"\\A[0-9a-fA-F]{64}\\z"))throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid resource digest.");if(r.EmbeddedBase64 is {} encoded){if(encoded.Length>MaximumBytes)throw new InvalidDataException("Embedded resource exceeds size limit.");byte[] bytes;try{bytes=Convert.FromBase64String(encoded);}catch(FormatException ex){throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid embedded resource encoding: "+r.Id,ex);}if(r.Sha256 is not null&&!string.Equals(Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(bytes)),r.Sha256,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))throw new InvalidDataException("Embedded resource digest mismatch: "+r.Id);}}
